description: Replaces case-06 as pair 2 (K3). The purchase limit (at most 20 units of one SKU per order) is checked only in OrderController.create. PlaceOrderService and the Order aggregate do not check it, although the quantity reaches both, so any other entry point creates orders that break the invariant. The twin (case-09t) has the same code shape: the guard checks the gift note length against the same constant instead. Neither file carries an explanatory comment.

misplacedResponsibilities.responsibility: Enforces the purchase limit (at most 20 units of one SKU per order), a business invariant of the Order aggregate.
